style: Intimate instrumental tactical game score in a dark glass signal hall. A felt piano, muted celesta and plucked synthesizer sequences interlock over a sustained low cello and cold analog pad. Small irregular metallic clicks and dry rim taps add anxious motion beneath a slow, sad minor melody. Quiet, mysterious, unresolved, with long tape echoes and no large drum beat. Purely instrumental. Em, 100 BPM.
